description:
Skin name typeahead. Up to 10 skins whose name matches `q`, best match first (the same ILIKE + trigram search the site's search
boxes use). Each result is `{itemdefid, name, icon_url}`; use the `itemdefid` with the other skin endpoints.
For filtered, paginated results use GET /skins with `search=` instead.

q.description: Part of a skin name (2+ characters).

name: search_skins
title: Skin name typeahead
